description: What changed in the MCP and A2A specifications since a date, each as a short summary in our own words with a link to the release notes. A short curated list, not a full changelog. Good for 'What changed in the MCP spec this year?'. Example: spec_changes_since(date="2026-01-01") -> {count, changes: [{spec, tag, date, summary, source}]}. Date format YYYY-MM-DD.
name: spec_changes_since
